newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to redeem callable notes.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to redeem callable notes.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Friday that on January 10 it will redeem the following callable notes in their entirety:
*Accrued interest of $31.31 per $1,000 face amount will also be paid on January 10. The notes are worth a par amount of $100 million. **Accrued interest of $34 per $1,000 face amount will also

Sallie Mae said principal will be repaid at 100 percent of the face amount. Payment will be made to holders of record as of the close of business January 9, it said.
